snippet.title: Sivers // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402230/Sivers/

Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Nazar Baranovskyi, Rockstar Games
📚 Publisher: Nazar Baranovskyi, Rockstar Games
📅 Release Date: Oct 20, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy
